title: Onboarding stalls: one stall nudge picks up where it left off

answers.what: phone out of the bedroom and lights out by 11

history.text: I want to stop scrolling in bed, I'm up till 1 most nights
Up till 1 is rough, Leo. What time would you actually like to be asleep by?
11 it is. Where does the phone usually end up when you get into bed?

testerLines: sorry, crazy day. on the nightstand, right next to my head lol
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: no case covered a stalled onboarding.
shouldHaveHappened: About 3 hours after ZOH's unanswered question, one text ZOH starts itself: warm, with Leo's name, picking up where it left off (where the phone ends up at night) rather than starting over, in 1 to 3 sentences with one question, and no guilt about the silence. Only one such text by 15:30. His reply carries onboarding on naturally from what he said, without re-asking anything already settled (11 pm, the phone out of the bedroom).
